quests.name: Guarding the Dimrill Stair
quests.reward: Gain 2 favor and receive training. Then place Gandalf in Bree and reveal Beravor's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: Spies in Mithlond
quests.setup: Place Gandalf in The Grey Havens. When you would draw Encounter cards at The Hrey Havens, combat a Crebain instead.
quests.reward: Gain a "Boat" Item card and receive training. Then reveal Beravor's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: Bones of a Darkness Past
quests.reward: Gain 2 favor and 1 level of agility.

quests.name: They Have Become Queer and Wild
quests.reward: Gain 2 favor and receive training. Then place Thranduil in Woodland Realm and reveal Argalad's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: The Forest Must Provide No Refuge
quests.setup: Place Aragorn in The South Eaves. When you would draw Encounter cards in The South Eaves, combat an Orc instead.
quests.reward: Receive training. Then reveal Argalad's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: Echoes of Bolg's Army
quests.reward: Gain 2 favor or 1 level of fortitude. Then force Sauron to discard 1 random Shadow card from his hand.

quests.name: An Appeal to Golasgil
quests.reward: Gain 1 favor, receive training, and place Boromir in Osgiliath. Then shuffle your rest pool into your life pool and reveal Eleanor's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: Where the Stars are Strange
quests.task: Explore Near Harad or combat the Black Serpent.
quests.reward: Gain 1 level of strength and receive training. Then place Denethor in Minas Tirith and reveal Eleanor's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: Hidden in the Ash Mountains
quests.reward: Gain 2 favor or 1 level of agility. Then remove 1 influence from the Shadow Pool.

quests.name: Drive Back the Evil Men
quests.task: Explore the Mouth of the Greyflood.
quests.reward: Gain 2 favor and place Saruman in Isengard. Then reveal Eometh's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: A message to the White Wizard
quests.setup: Place Saruman in Isengard. When you would draw Encounter cards in Isengard, combat an Agent instead.
quests.reward: Gain 1 favor and receive training. Then reveal Eometh's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: Hill of Sorcery
quests.reward: Gain 2 favor or 1 level of agility. Sauron must then choose to either discard 1 plot card from his hand or 2 influence from the Shadow Pool.

quests.name: The Ered Luin
quests.reward: Gain 3 favor and place Dain II in Erebor. Then shuffle your rest pool into your life pool and reveal Thálin's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: A New Threat
quests.setup: Place Dain II in The Northern Wast. When you would draw Encounter cards in The Northern Waste, combat a Snaga instead.
quests.reward: Receive training. Then reveal Thálin's Advanced Quest.

quests.name: To Look into the Mirrormere
quests.reward: Gain 2 favor or 1 level of wisdom.
